newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sells Seguros Profesional for $2.3mln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sells Seguros Profesional for $2.3mln.

text.p: Venezuela's state Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade sold small insurance company Seguros Profesional on Monday to a group of local investors for 1.1 billion bolivars ($2.3 million).

The group led by Rodolfo Bartha paid 500 million bolivars ($1.1 million) over the base price to secure the 97.05 percent stake on offer. Fogade inherited Seguros Profesional during the take-over of Banco Profesional in 1995.

Seguros Profesional specializes mostly in vehicle insurance, which accounts for 45 percent of its portfolio, followed by health insurance with 25 percent and fire insurance with 10 percent, Fogade officials said.

Bartha, a former president of leading local insurance company Seguros La Seguridad said he was seeking to form a partnership with U.S. investors who would be offered a 50 percent stake in Seguros Profesional next year.
It is the third insurance company Fogade has sold this year as it liquidates assets received as guarantees for financial aid to banks during the 1994-5 banking sector crisis.
